summary: Prioritize an email, LinkedIn, or other inbox, draft replies, and review the cleanup that would bring it under control.

useCases.title: Triage an inbox
useCases.message: Help me triage this inbox. Bring forward what needs attention, draft the useful replies, and show me any cleanup or delegation before taking action.

useCases.title: Bring an inbox under control
useCases.message: Review the communication queue I choose and help me deal with the important messages without treating every unread item as urgent.

useCases.title: Sort incoming messages
useCases.message: Prioritize this email, LinkedIn, or messaging inbox and prepare the replies, follow-ups, and cleanup I should review.
